I will apply some inorganic fertilizer on this plot—about 30 kilograms of nitrogen per hectare—because I can get subsidized DAP and urea through our cooperative, though the amount is often late and never enough. I will also spread manure because my household keeps livestock and the soil needs the organic matter, and I will use my own saved local barley seed since improved barley seed is hard to find in our area. I will not use pesticides or irrigate because this highland plot depends on the meher rains and barley does not have serious pest problems here. My family will work about 30 days on this plot over the season, from ploughing with our oxen through harvest and threshing, but I will not hire outside labor since the plot is small and my children can help with the heavy tasks.
